name: Popmento – Popup Builder for Elementor
author: Michael

sections.description:
Popmento – Popup Builder for Elementor adds a custom popup post type (popmento_popups) that integrates seamlessly into the Elementor editor. Build and style your popups with the full power of Elementor, then fine-tune their behavior with dedicated settings:

  • Design freely – Use Elementor’s full widget library and theme builder to create any popup layout.
  • Trigger options – Display after a delay, on scroll, or on click.
  • Page targeting – Show on the entire site, selected pages only, or exclude specific pages.
  • Frequency control – Show always, X times per day, or X times per session via cookies.
  • Entry animations – Fade in, slide in from top/bottom/left/right.
  • Alignment – Center, left, right, top, bottom positioning.
  • Scheduling – Set an expiry date to auto-disable popups.
  • Close button toggle – Show or hide the close button with a modern X control.
  • Admin list toggle – Quick-enable or disable popups from the posts list.
  • Admin bar shortcut – Clear popup cookies directly from the frontend admin bar.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor (free version is sufficient).
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins > Add New.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  4. A new Popups menu item appears in the WordPress admin (navigate to Elementor > Editor > Popups).
  5. Add a new popup, edit with Elementor, and configure the display settings in the Elementor panel under Settings > Popup Settings.
sections.faq:
Can I use any Elementor widget inside a popup?

Yes. Since popups are built with the full Elementor editor, you can use any widget, including forms, images, buttons, and custom HTML.

Can I target specific pages?

Yes. The Display On setting lets you choose between the entire site, selected pages only, or all pages except specified ones.

How does the frequency system work?

You can show the popup every time (always), limit it to a number of times per day, or per session. Cookies are used to track impressions and expire automatically.

Can I set an end date for a popup?

Yes. Set the Until option to Until Date and pick a date/time. The popup will automatically disable itself after that time.

How do I clear my popup cookies for testing?

While logged in, click Clear Popup Cookies in the frontend admin bar.
